trickyParts: isRunning: false is passed explicitly: omitted, assistant-ui reads a trailing running assistant message as a running thread.

The page, AgentRuntimeThread and its one runtime survive a session switch (route has no key), so drafts are swapped in a useLayoutEffect on sessionId; a refusal restores via runtime.thread.composer.setText only while its session is on screen, otherwise into that session's kept draft.

AgentRuntimeThread's prop is now onSend(session, body) -> 'sent' | 'refused' (it never rejects); the page's error line is a per-session Map; ownSendCount bumps only when the landed send's session is on screen; the stored-list refresh is not awaited and is outside the refusal.
